label: List instance infra
description: List every copy of one infra node that exists: the shared one, if the node has one, and each instance's copy of a node marked `@per_instance`, each with its state. For an overview of which instance has what running, or to find the copies to stop.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The infra node, named the way the program writes it (`bridge`, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).

outputs.name: copies
outputs.description: One entry per copy: `{ node, instance?, status, failure? }`. `instance` is missing on the shared copy; `status` is provisioning, running, flaky, stopping, stopped, terminating or failed, and `failure` says why when it failed.

outputs.name: instances
outputs.description: The instances that have a copy, whatever its state.

then.message: ListInstanceInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program. Name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).
